name: Dream King
caption: Held the federation's own Heavyweight Championship for four months before dropping it at the fed's own pay-per-view, Slaughter in the Hell, then reclaimed the same title lineage by submission the following February.
notes: The federation's own recruitment/results post, dated 5 December 1998, recapping its own recent pay-per-view "Slaughter in the Hell".
